info.title: SuSuMonitor AI API (Diagnosis, Q&A & Health Reports)
info.description: Read-only diagnosis contract implemented at code level (Java module ai). The endpoint is gated by susumonitor.ai.enabled (default false): while disabled the Controller bean is not loaded and requests receive 404 after the security chain. When enabled, the service sends only allowlisted, validated, fail-closed monitoring summaries to a configured provider. It never sends credentials, SSH data, terminal frames, raw terminal input/output, or write-operation instructions, and it never grants tools or execution access to a model. Provider failures (timeout/5xx/invalid response) return HTTP 200 with a deterministic fallback and model_used=false; the provider error code is recorded in ai_diagnostic_runs.error_code. 429 responses with a Retry-After-capable provider are retried in-process (bounded, default 2 attempts); only 429 and transient network errors are retried. Governance: per-admin fixed-window rate limit and a daily token budget (susumonitor.ai.daily-token-budget, 0=unlimited) both reject with 42906 before any provider call. By default the provider endpoint must use HTTPS; susumonitor.ai.allow-insecure-http=true explicitly permits plaintext http:// for controlled intranet/integration use only (the API key then transits unencrypted - not recommended for production).

servers.description: Local development server; endpoint only exists when susumonitor.ai.enabled=true

post.description: Admin-only read-only MVP endpoint implemented in Java module ai (controller AiDiagnosisController, conditional on susumonitor.ai.enabled=true). Requires an active admin Bearer JWT. The service validates server access, reads only an allowlisted monitoring summary, applies fail-closed checks, and calls a provider selected from a server-side fixed configuration. The request cannot select a provider URL, API key, tool, callback, or prompt. AI output is advisory only: it cannot open or consume terminal frames, use SSH, execute commands, or perform any write operation.

example.question: Why did CPU usage rise during the selected window?

data.summary: CPU saturation coincided with elevated load and reduced available memory.

findings.title: Sustained CPU utilization
findings.description: CPU remained above the warning range for part of the selected window.

recommendations: Review the workload associated with the observed interval using approved operational procedures.
limitations: This is an advisory, read-only analysis and does not execute or validate any remediation.
No terminal, SSH, raw log, or credential data was provided to the model.

post.summary: Ask an operations question with read-only tools
post.description: Admin-only operations Q&A (F2, Java module ai, controller AiQaController). Assembly is gated by susumonitor.ai.enabled (404 while off) and the service additionally short-circuits with 50304 while susumonitor.ai.qa.enabled=false. The model may only call platform-registered read-only tools (server status, latest metrics, metrics history, alert records, command template whitelist, pending-approval command proposals); tool calls are bounded per request (susumonitor.ai.qa.max-tool-iterations, default 6) and every call is audited to ai_qa_runs.tool_calls_json. propose_command_run only creates pending_approval proposals rendered from the server-side template whitelist; nothing executes on any host until a human administrator approves. Per-admin fixed-window rate limit and a daily token budget (susumonitor.ai.qa.daily-token-budget, 0=unlimited) reject with 42906 before any provider call. Provider failures degrade: tool-assisted mode falls back to a no-tools single call, then to a deterministic server-aggregated summary (HTTP 200, model_used=false, degraded=true); the original error code is recorded in ai_qa_runs.error_code.

example.question: What is the current CPU and memory situation of this server, and are there any unresolved alerts?

data.answer: CPU is at 23% and memory at 61%; the only unresolved alert is a warning-level disk alert triggered at 08:12 UTC.

get.description: Returns the caller's personal provider config; the API key is masked (first 3 / last 4). Admin-only.

put.description: Upserts the caller's personal provider config. api_key is stored AES-256-GCM encrypted (AAD bound to the user id) and never returned; a blank api_key keeps the stored key. Endpoints must be HTTPS unless susumonitor.ai.allow-insecure-http=true. Personal config takes precedence over the global susumonitor.ai.* config for the caller's sync AI calls (diagnosis / QA / command suggestions).

delete.description: Removes the caller's personal provider config; subsequent AI calls fall back to the global config. data indicates whether a config existed.

post.description: Performs one minimal chat completion call with the given endpoint/key/model (blank api_key reuses the stored key). The test is not audited and does not consume rate limit or budget.

200.description: Test result (ok=false with a stable error code when the provider call fails)

get.description: Admin-only paginated history of generated daily health reports, newest first. Assembly is gated by susumonitor.ai.report.enabled (404 while off). Each item carries report_date (unique per day), status (succeeded/degraded), LLM summary (null when degraded), top_concerns, limitations and the aggregated facts snapshot (metrics_json). Degraded reports additionally expose error_code (e.g. 42906 when the daily token budget was exhausted on the scheduler path).

Admin-only full report view: summary, top_concerns ("worth-attention three things"), limitations, the aggregated facts snapshot and provider usage. 404 when the report does not exist. The facts snapshot is authoritative (server-side SQL aggregation); model text is interpretation only.

post.summary: Generate a health report on demand
post.description: Admin-only manual trigger (idempotent regeneration). report_date defaults to yesterday and must not be in the future; regeneration for the same report_date overwrites the stored row via UPSERT (uk_ai_health_reports_date). The pipeline: read-only aggregation -> daily token budget check -> single provider call -> persist -> best-effort notification. Provider absence/failure degrades to a facts-only report with status=degraded and never blocks the main flow; per-admin fixed-window rate limit and the daily token budget reject manual triggers with 42906.

200.description: Generated (or regenerated) report; status=degraded when the model summary was unavailable

bearerAuth.description: JWT for an active user with the admin role.

XRequestId.name: X-Request-ID
XRequestId.description: Documentation-only header. The server ignores any client-supplied X-Request-ID (RequestIdFilter) and always generates a fresh UUID, which is returned in the response and written to the AI audit row.

XCorrelationId.name: X-Correlation-ID
XCorrelationId.description: Optional client trace correlation ID. Only [A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64} is accepted; invalid values are silently dropped. Do not include credentials or prompt content.

XRequestId.description: Server request ID for audit and support correlation.

XCorrelationId.description: Correlation ID propagated for request tracing.

InvalidRequestParameter.description: Invalid request parameter or body (candidate business code 40002).

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid, expired, or inactive JWT (40100).

Forbidden.description: Authenticated user is not an active administrator (40300).

NotFound.description: Server does not exist or is soft-deleted (40400).

AiRateLimited.description: AI limit reached (42906): per-admin fixed-window rate limit, daily token budget exhausted, or global concurrency permits exhausted. No provider request is made; rate-limit and budget rejections create no audit row.

AiInternalError.description: Unexpected internal orchestration failure (50000 internal server error). Note: 50003 is reserved for SSH authentication failure and is not used by this endpoint.

AiProviderUnavailable.description: Provider is unavailable or rejected (50303). Current MVP behavior: converted to HTTP 200 deterministic fallback (model_used=false); 50303 is recorded in ai_diagnostic_runs.error_code. This response definition is retained for a future strict mode with fallback disabled.

AiDisabledOrRedactionFailed.description: Provider configuration invalid or fail-closed policy validation failed (50304). When the kill switch is off (susumonitor.ai.enabled=false) the endpoint does not exist and returns 404 instead; 50304 only occurs while enabled with an invalid provider configuration. Current MVP behavior: converted to HTTP 200 deterministic fallback (model_used=false) and recorded in ai_diagnostic_runs.error_code.

AiProviderTimeout.description: Provider connection or response timeout (50401). Current MVP behavior: converted to HTTP 200 deterministic fallback (model_used=false) and recorded in ai_diagnostic_runs.error_code.

server_id.description: Optional target server for the question; omit for global questions.

question.description: Administrator question, treated as untrusted text; effective max length is tightened by susumonitor.ai.qa.max-question-length (default 2000).

answer.description: Model answer; deterministic server-aggregated summary when degraded.

tool_calls.description: Read-only tools actually called by the model in this turn (call audit).

model_used.description: false for the deterministic fallback summary.

degraded.description: true when the tool-assisted call fell back to no-tools mode or deterministic summary.

tool.description: Whitelisted tool name (get_server_status / get_latest_metrics / get_metrics_history / list_alert_records / list_command_templates / propose_command_run).

args.description: Controlled parameter summary; no credentials or sensitive data.

server_id.description: Non-deleted server to diagnose; access is rechecked server-side.

question.description: Administrator question. Treated as untrusted text and cannot override system policy or request tools/actions.

history_minutes.description: UTC monitoring history window in minutes. Final required/default/range semantics require Java confirmation.

summary.description: Concise advisory diagnosis; not a statement that any remediation was executed.

model_used.description: Whether a provider model actually produced the diagnosis; false for deterministic fallback if Java supports one.

provider.description: Server-selected allowlisted provider identifier; never a user-supplied URL or secret.

prompt_version.description: Version of the server-controlled prompt and output policy.

value.description: Allowlisted numeric or null metric summary value.

estimated_cost.description: Server-calculated estimate; final currency and precision require Java/provider confirmation.

configured.description: Whether the caller has a personal provider config.

provider.description: Provider identifier; currently fixed to openai-compatible.

api_key_masked.description: Masked API key (first 3 / last 4); the plaintext never leaves the server.

enabled.description: false disables the personal config so global config applies.

data.description: true when a stored config was removed; false when none existed.

base_url.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint; must be HTTPS unless susumonitor.ai.allow-insecure-http=true.

api_key.description: Plaintext API key; blank keeps the stored key. Stored AES-256-GCM encrypted.

error_code.description: Stable business error code when ok=false.

code.description: Candidate AI codes are provisional and must align with Java ErrorCode before implementation.

report_date.description: Natural day the report covers (defaults to yesterday; must not be in the future).
Natural day the report covers; unique per day.

model.description: Configured model identifier; empty when degraded.

summary.description: One-page model narrative; null when degraded.

limitations.description: What the report cannot determine (e.g. offline list is a snapshot, not a disconnect event log).

facts.description: Aggregated facts snapshot (server inventory, metric peaks, alert statistics, offline servers); authoritative data.

error_code.description: Degradation reason as business code (e.g. 42906); null when succeeded.

duration_ms.description: Aggregation + provider call + persistence total duration in ms.
